faqItems.question: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqItems.answer: Porcelain veneers typically last 15–20 years or longer with proper care. Our veneers are hand-crafted by master ceramists for exceptional fit, natural translucency, and long-term durability.

faqItems.question: How many visits does veneer treatment take?
faqItems.answer: The treatment process for porcelain veneers typically involves a few visits, from initial consultation and design to preparation and final bonding, ensuring a precise and beautiful outcome.

faqItems.question: Veneers vs. crowns vs. bonding — what's right for me?
faqItems.answer: Veneers cover the front surface of a tooth with minimal reduction for cosmetic improvements, while crowns encase the entire tooth for structural compromise. Bonding is a cost-effective same-day option. Our doctors will recommend the most conservative treatment for your goals.

faqItems.question: Will my teeth be ground down for veneers?
faqItems.answer: Porcelain veneers require minimal tooth reduction, making them a preferred choice for cosmetic enhancements. The goal is to preserve as much natural tooth structure as possible.

faqItems.question: Do you offer financing for cosmetic dentistry?
faqItems.answer: The cost of porcelain veneers varies based on several factors. We provide a detailed, transparent treatment plan during your consultation so you know exactly what to expect. Please contact us for specific pricing details.

faqItems.question: Can I see what my new smile will look like first?
faqItems.answer: Yes, our Atelier Aesthetics in-house smile creation center allows you to see your new smile come to life through mockups and advanced technology before any work begins.

doctor.name: Dr. Robert Rifkin
doctor.bio: With over four decades of experience, Dr. Robert Rifkin has earned a reputation as one of the best cosmetic dentists in the world, trusted by Hollywood's biggest names. A graduate of St. Louis University School of Dentistry with advanced post-graduate training, he is also an adjunct faculty member at UCLA and a member of prestigious dental academies. Dr. Rifkin's philosophy centers on transforming lives through beautiful, healthy smiles, never producing unnatural-looking results. He has authored papers on full mouth reconstruction, facial analysis, and aesthetic dentistry.
